visual_review: Direct full-page review shows a sword fight before a pale walled courtyard with repeated curved tiled gate tops, black overhead sky/tree masses and strongly directed blue-violet illumination on walls and figures. Foreground dark shapes remain distinct against brighter whitewash, with warm skin/red costume accents. The Archive caption explicitly identifies The Magic Blade (1976); interpreting the black sky and stage lighting as a night exterior is a visual inference, not a captioned scene time. Useful for Yihong courtyard silhouette, cool-lit whitewash and warm/cool separation after the reduced-green revision. No warm lantern/window practical is visible, so this cannot alone establish the site's amber-window treatment. It does not establish surveyed Yihong geometry, exact light positions, a green wash or the required Magic Blade cave scene.
